instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a shallow depth of field, captured in a medium shot at eye-level. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, backed by a dense forest of green trees, two men are shaking hands. On the left, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) stands facing right, wearing black shorts and smiling broadly. On the right, the man in the grey t-shirt (R4) stands facing left, wearing grey sweatpants, with his back partially to the camera as he shakes hands with his friend. The warm interaction is captured in soft, natural daylight filtering through the trees, creating a sun-drenched and friendly atmosphere.
